items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Richie used to play with Johnny Fisher when he used to play the parades

ctx.x: Not one. Not even a kazoo? Not even a kazoo. Didn't sing or anything? No. I doubt a very few families out of New Orleans had a family musical background. Maybe the Detroit's and the Christians. Well, the Brunesses might have had one at that time. Oh, yeah. The old man played violin. Well, not my family.

Yeah. But I have two sisters. Merritt and Henry, the ones used to play around more so than Richie. Richie used to play with Johnny Fisher when he used to play the parades and all that. It was more of a big band. They played 10 to 12 men in your band, you know.
